consent.title: Before you start
consent.p1: It does not judge fault, payout amounts, or medical care.
consent.p2: Your details stay on this phone.
consent.p3: If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 119 or 112 first.
consent.d1: Photos are sent to a server for AI analysis.
consent.d2: If you use Ask a question, your question is sent to a server and answered by an AI model. Do not include names or other personal details.
consent.d3: In the demo, use example photos, not real accident information.
consent.d4: After you agree, the app reads its questions aloud and listens for your answer. You can answer by voice or by tapping.
consent.d5: If you answer by voice, your browser may send what you say to its own speech service.
consent.d6: The first time, your browser asks to use the microphone. Allow it once and it will not ask again on this device.

privacy.1: ScenePilot guides what to check and do at an accident scene. It does not decide fault, compensation, or medical care.
privacy.2: Your insurance and saved records stay on this device. These records do not contain original photos, conversation transcripts or audio.
privacy.3: Photo analysis and questions send the photo or question to the server and NVIDIA models on Nebius. Other-driver details, reporting checks, call results and follow-up notes may also update the server accident session. Sessions exist in server memory.
privacy.4: AI coaching sends recent conversation text to the server and model. Heard details are shown as unconfirmed until you check them.
privacy.5: Voice answers use browser speech recognition. The browser may send audio to its own speech service. You can use buttons instead of the microphone.
privacy.6: Clearing device data does not clear server sessions or downloaded backup files. Backup files contain personal data, so keep them appropriately.
handover.contactTooLong: Keep the claim number and contact details within 40 characters each.
handover.contactNotice: Saving updates the contact state, claim number and contact details in the server accident session and keeps a device copy. Reporting checks change only when you select them.
handover.contactLocal: The call record could not reach the server. It was saved in the device copy.
handover.callBasis: These sentences use answers given at the scene. Also check the directly entered time, health and moving-assistance details above.
handover.followupNote: Keep the original record and append later information with its time.
handover.noteLabel: What I learned later (up to 300 characters)
handover.noteLimit: Enter a non-empty note of up to 300 characters. Each record allows 20 notes.
handover.noteSaved: Follow-up note added to the accident record.
handover.noteLocal: The server session is unavailable. The follow-up note was saved on this device.
handover.localNote: Note kept on this device only
handover.copyEditNote: This screen edits the copy kept on this device. You can append later information as follow-up notes.
